items.title: Kenya: Ambassador Del Monaco Unveils Work of Art at the Residence in Nairobi

items.title: Aosta Valley Region Signs Agreement to Participate in Expo 2027 Belgrade
items.description: (ANSA) - BELGRADO, 27 NOV - The Commissioner of the Italian Pavilion at Expo 2027 Belgrade, Ambassador to Serbia Luca Gori, and the President of the Autonomous Region of Valle d’Aosta, Aurelio Marguerettaz, signed the agreement outlining the terms of the Region’s participation in the International Specialized Exposition, scheduled to take place in the Serbian capital from May 15 to August 15, 2027. items.title: Italy-Vietnam Agreement on Food Safety and Public Health
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 26 NOV - As part of Italian Cuisine Week in Vietnam, a workshop titled “Food Safety: Framework and Prospects in Italy and the EU. Implications for Vietnam and Other Exporting Countries” was held today. The workshop, organized by the Italian Embassy in Vietnam at Casa Italia, focused on food safety, control systems, and the traceability of agri-food products, with an emphasis on the European and Vietnamese regulatory frameworks and opportunities for cooperation.
